info.name: Odoo - Phieu ho tro
info.description: Dat base_url trong Postman Environment thanh domain Odoo dang su dung (gom http:// hoac https://, khong co dau / cuoi). Module tu tao Thong so he thong core_fastapi.api_key voi Gia tri ngau nhien khi nap database da cai core_fastapi; Gia tri co san duoc giu nguyen. Khi doi database, khong can tao thu cong: tim core_fastapi.api_key trong Cai dat > Ky thuat > Tham so > Thong so he thong, sao chep Gia tri vao api_key va chay truc tiep request 5. URL tickets la /api/v1/tickets, khong dien URL vao Gia tri. Cac request 2-4 dung session: nhap username/password va chay request 1 truoc. Endpoint /api/session/authenticate tu chon database duy nhat theo domain va cau hinh dbfilter/db_name cua server; khong can gui db. API dung route tuong doi, khong gan co dinh domain. Khong dung token auth.datgroup.com.vn.

variable.description: Domain Odoo hien tai, gom http:// hoac https:// va khong co dau / cuoi. Dat bien nay trong Environment cho tung moi truong. Postman can URL tuyet doi va khong tu suy ra domain cua website.

Gia tri bi mat cua Thong so he thong core_fastapi.api_key duoc tao tu dong khi nap database, hoac Gia tri ban tu dat. Moi database tao Gia tri rieng neu chua co; khi doi database sao chep Gia tri cua database moi vao Environment. Request 5 gui qua header X-API-Key, khong can dang nhap hay cau hinh User/Company cua FastAPI Endpoint.

request.description: Khong can truyen db. Server phai cau hinh domain khop dung mot database qua dbfilter hoac db_name. Dang nhap thanh cong tao session_id de goi cac API tickets.

item.name: 3. Tim phieu theo ma khach hang so huu

request.description: Dien card_code bang ma khach hang so huu (res.partner.card_code), vi du C020957. Response owner_id.card_code la ma khach hang.

item.name: 4. Tim tat ca phieu theo card_code trong Body JSON

request.description: Chay dang nhap truoc. Gui GET voi Body JSON card_code, vi du C020957; khong can Params. Tra tat ca phieu duoc phep xem cua khach hang so huu co ma chinh xac, khong phan trang.

item.name: 5. Lay phieu ho tro bang API key (khong dang nhap)

request.description: Chay truc tiep khong can request dang nhap. Tai Cai dat > Ky thuat > Tham so > Thong so he thong, tim core_fastapi.api_key da duoc tao tu dong; sao chep Gia tri vao api_key cua Environment. Khong can tao ban ghi thu cong khi doi database; Gia tri co san khong bi ghi de. Co the doi Value bang chuoi bi mat rieng. URL GET la {{base_url}}/api/v1/tickets. Khoa cap quyen doc tickets va du lieu lien quan tren toan database, khong can cau hinh User/Company cua FastAPI Endpoint. API tao/sua/xoa van yeu cau dang nhap. Khi doi database, dung Gia tri cua database moi. Co the them query card_code de loc theo ma khach hang.
